openProjects.title: Microstructure Classifier
openProjects.description: A computer vision model to classify different types of material microstructures.
openProjects.longDescription: Build and evaluate deep convolutional neural networks to automatically identify grain boundaries, phases, and defect distributions in SEM/TEM metallographic images. This open project aims to accelerate automated microstructure characterization for materials research.
goals: Curate and benchmark 1,000+ labeled metallographic microstructure images
Train ResNet-50 and Vision Transformer baselines with >92% classification accuracy
Export lightweight ONNX models for web and edge device deployment
requirements: Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow for image classification models
Basic understanding of optical/SEM metallographic image processing using OpenCV
Standard GitHub collaboration workflow (forking, branching, pull requests)

openProjects.title: Crystal Lattice Defect Simulator
openProjects.description: Simulating point defects, vacancies, and dislocation loops in high-entropy alloys.
openProjects.longDescription: Perform atomistic Molecular Dynamics simulations using LAMMPS and Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE) to calculate vacancy formation energies and dislocation migration barriers in multicomponent alloys.
goals: Simulate NPT thermal relaxation across 5 alloy compositions
Calculate vacancy formation energies with EAM potentials
requirements: Experience running LAMMPS scripts or Quantum ESPRESSO
Python scripting for ASE structure manipulation

openProjects.title: High-Entropy Alloy Phase Predictor
openProjects.description: Predict single-phase solid solution formation in HEAs using thermodynamic descriptors.
openProjects.longDescription: Developing an interactive web application that predicts solid-solution vs intermetallic phase formation in multi-principal element alloys based on valence electron concentration, mixing enthalpy, and atomic size mismatch.
goals: Build clean Streamlit web dashboard for real-time phase prediction

openProjects.title: Thermodynamic Phase Diagram Calculator
openProjects.description: Algorithmic generation of binary phase diagrams from Gibbs free energy models.
openProjects.longDescription: Generates equilibrium binary phase diagrams using common tangent construction on regular solution Gibbs free energy curves.
